title: Echoes of the boom in hydraulic fracturing: What changes in Louisiana's energy complex reveal about global energy cycles
abstract: arXiv:2611.28309v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The expansion of hydraulic fracturing (i.e. fracking) led to global shifts in energy markets that were felt acutely along the US Gulf Coast and particularly in the state of Louisiana. This article presents a data-focused examination of trends in the energy industry, and shows how they led to potentially counterintuitive, negative impacts in Louisiana's economy. Most notably, hydraulic fracturing led to a massive expansion in oil and gas supplies that contributed to a significant decline in oil prices in late 2014, contributing to significant job losses. Louisiana's economic downturns were tied to global shifts in energy markets that had major geostrategic implications. More broadly, results indicate that large and long period cycles in the supply, demand and price of oil can have widespread impacts on job creation and loss. translated_title: 水力压裂繁荣的回响：路易斯安那州能源综合体的变化揭示了全球能源周期
translated_abstract: 水力压裂（即压裂法开采）的扩张引发了全球能源市场的转变，这些转变在美国墨西哥湾沿岸感受尤为强烈，特别是路易斯安那州。本文以数据为重点对能源行业趋势进行了考察，展示了这些趋势如何在路易斯安那州经济中造成了可能违反直觉的负面影响。最值得注意的是，水力压裂导致石油和天然气供应大幅扩张，促成了2014年底油价的显著下跌，进而造成大量就业岗位流失。路易斯安那州的经济衰退与具有重大地缘战略影响的全球能源市场转变密切相关。更广泛地说，研究结果表明，石油供应、需求和价格的大规模长周期波动会对就业的产生与流失产生广泛影响。在路易斯安那州这样拥有庞大且多样化能源综合体的州，这些趋势的影响可能高度不均衡。
tldr: 本文通过数据分析揭示，水力压裂引发的全球能源市场转变导致油价大幅下跌，反而在路易斯安那州造成了违反直觉的负面经济冲击和大量失业，表明石油供需与价格的长周期波动对就业具有广泛而深远的影响。
en_tdlr: This data-driven study reveals that the fracking-induced global energy market shifts and subsequent oil price decline caused counterintuitive negative economic impacts and significant job losses in Louisiana, demonstrating that long-period cycles in oil supply, demand, and price can have widespread effects on employment.
